description: This file contains navigation utility functions for a web application, including URL manipulation, hash navigation, event management, and route resolution based on configuration.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates to a specified URL, optionally replacing history or notifying via popstate event.

methods.name: hashNavigate
methods.description: Performs hash-based navigation, optionally adding a nonce and notifying hashchange event.

methods.name: useQueryParams
methods.description: React hook to parse query parameters from the URL.

methods.name: parseQuery
methods.description: Parses a query string into an object of key-value pairs.

methods.name: getQueryString
methods.description: Returns the current URL's query string.

methods.name: getQueryParams
methods.description: Returns parsed query parameters as an object.

methods.name: getHomeRoute
methods.description: Determines the home route based on configuration.

methods.name: extendHomeRoute
methods.description: Appends a route to the home route.

methods.name: hardNavigate
methods.description: Navigates to a route by opening it in the same window.

methods.name: makeURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL with route, hash, and search parameters.
